title: Migrate Claude Workflows with Evidence
summary: Inventory dependencies, separate portable contracts from Claude-specific behavior, compare candidates, canary safely, and preserve rollback when changing models or providers.
objectives: Inventory model, prompt, API, content-block, tool, data, safety, and operational dependencies.
Separate portable application contracts from Claude-specific capabilities and behavior.
Use controlled evaluation and canary evidence instead of assuming model substitution is equivalent.
Migrate with coexistence, monitoring, rollback, and deprecation ownership.

paragraphs: Run baseline and candidate against identical representative, edge, adversarial, and incident cases. sections.title: Migrate reversibly and close deliberately
paragraphs: Use configurable routing, versioned prompts and adapters, compatible data migrations, dual-read or dual-run patterns when justified, and a tested rollback path. activity.title: Plan and rehearse a Claude migration
instructions: Inventory one workflow across code, configuration, prompts, messages, tools, data, evaluations, telemetry, operations, and deployment platform.
Create a portable-versus-Claude-specific contract table and map each incompatible behavior to an adapter, redesign, or explicit non-support decision.
Run a baseline/candidate evaluation and define canary, promotion, hold, rollback, and deprecation-exit criteria.
Rehearse rollback from a synthetic failed canary and record timing, evidence, data reconciliation, owners, and communication.
evidence: A dependency inventory and compatibility matrix with official migration and lifecycle sources for the exact deployment.
A baseline/candidate report, canary plan, successful rollback rehearsal, and signed production closeout checklist.

Guide the inventory, compatibility matrix, evaluation, canary, rollback rehearsal, and closeout evidence.
